notes: Modified-cash-basis school district (FY ends 2025-08-31), governmental funds only, no business-type funds (school nutrition is reported as a governmental fund here). Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4, continuation of p3). Roll-forward 837,634.81 + 3,533,337.75 - 3,354,280.65 = 1,016,691.91 ties. Interfund transfers (General out 153,119.64 = to School Nutrition 95,000 + to Activities 58,119.64) net to zero in the total column through the Reclassification column, so top-level transfers_in/out are null; the transfer is in detail as other financing (General -, Activities and School Nutrition +). Statement receipt lines 'Local receipts', 'County receipts', 'State receipts', 'Activities', 'Interest' and 'Other' split using the General (p6), QCPU (p11), Activities (p8), School Nutrition (p9) and Special Building (p10) fund schedules; the splits sum to the printed lines. Re-check (attempt 2): State receipts 1,466,392.69 split into Homestead Exemption 10,079.76, Property Tax Credit 924,782.64, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 4,126.50 and remaining state aid 527,403.79 (fund schedule lines; General 1,401,677.31 + QCPU 64,242.45 + School Nutrition 472.93); carline receipts now Carline Tax; interest on taxes now Penalties and Interest on Taxes; ESU 140 now ESU Receipts; 'Support services' 1,098,704.81 split by the Statement of Activities p2 function lines (Pupils, Staff, General administration, Office of the principal -> School Administration, Business and technology -> Business, Operation/Maintenance of plant -> Building and Grounds, Pupil transportation); ECSE 1291/1292 detail lines now Special Education Programs; QCPU debt lines recorded one per printed line; balance sheet now from the governmental funds statement Total column (p4; totals equal the Statement of Net Position p1, fund balance by classification). QCPU fund disbursements 111,684.32 appear only in the total column (recorded in report_discrepancies); itemized from p11. Detail: General Fund receipts from the budget schedule p6; General Fund spending by object from Exhibit N (pp12-17), which supersedes the function-only General Fund disbursement schedule p7 (not entered, no double counting); transfers (912, 913) are inside the printed Total disbursements 3,065,541.98 and recorded as signed other financing with includes on the total; Exhibit N 5000 Debt payments (actual 0) and 'Other expenditures' (actual 0) and zero-actual object lines omitted; the 'Total state programs' printed again under Debt payments is a mislabel of the debt total (0 actual). Activities Fund recorded account by account from p18 (receipts 163,851.16 include 14,951.25 donations not separable by account; general fund support recorded as other financing per account, total 58,119.64); the one-line activities budget schedule p8 left out, and the 2024 comparative per-account schedule (p19) ignored. School Nutrition detail (p9): printed revenue total 160,307.58 includes the 95,000 transfer (includes other financing). Summary budget comparison p5 (fund totals only) not entered. Special Building roof line shown with actual 0 for its budget. Read pages 1-19 of 19
